    Sets whether to set every variable of the XDG Base Directory Specification, each to a location that differs from the specification's default: XDG_DATA_HOME=/xdg/data-home, XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/xdg/config-home, XDG_STATE_HOME=/xdg/state-home, XDG_CACHE_HOME=/xdg/cache-home, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/xdg/runtime-dir, XDG_DATA_DIRS=/xdg/data-dir/first:/xdg/data-dir/second and XDG_CONFIG_DIRS=/xdg/config-dir/first:/xdg/config-dir/second.
